name: ported barrel
description: A ported barrel redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improves recoil but increases noise and reduces accuracy slightly.

name: muzzle brake
description: A muzzle brake redirects exhaust gases to compensate for muzzle climb, improving recoil but increasing bulk, noise, and reducing accuracy slightly.

name: homemade suppressor
description: A homemade suppressor cobbled together out of spare parts.  While not nearly as effective as a regular suppressor, it will reduce the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels, as well as slightly reducing recoil and muzzle velocity.  This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

name: RK6S34 suppressor
description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  This RK6S34 Mustela is a rather advanced version integral to the RM11B rifle system.

name: shotgun suppressor
description: A suppressor designed to work with shotguns.  It's a lot more complex than a suppressor for a pistol or rifle.

name: suppressor
description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.

name: mp5sd integral suppressor
description: The integrated suppressor for the mp5sd.

name: flash hider
description: A flash hider vents propellant gases to the side to reduce muzzle flash, making the shooter harder to spot in low light.  Unlike a muzzle brake, it does not significantly increase noise.

name: compensator
description: A compensator vents gases upward to counteract muzzle rise, significantly improving accuracy during rapid fire.  More effective than a muzzle brake at taming recoil at the cost of a slight accuracy penalty at range.

name: rifle suppressor
description: A full-size suppressor designed specifically for rifle calibers.  Heavier and bulkier than pistol suppressors but significantly more effective, handling the higher gas volume and pressure of rifle cartridges.

name: linear compensator
description: A muzzle device that channels propellant gases forward rather than to the sides.  Reduces perceived recoil for the shooter and is more considerate of bystanders.  Popular on short-barreled rifles used in confined spaces.

name: compact suppressor
description: A compact suppressor designed for pistols and best used with smaller calibers.
